name: www.rapidly.co
description:
Test the idea before you build it. Rapidly works inside your AI agent.

Bring an idea you already have, or ask Rapidly to generate one from a company website. In about five minutes, Rapidly turns it into a Lean Canvas, a measurable hypothesis and pass mark, then designs practical Pretotyping experiments.

The result is a copy-ready build prompt for the smallest experiment worth running. Your agent builds the test. Real customers provide the evidence. The work is also saved in your Rapidly workspace so you can review it, continue it and record the result.

_published_faq.name: How do I add www.rapidly.co to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add www.rapidly.co to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.rapidly.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the www.rapidly.co MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: www.rapidly.co lists 21 MCP tools, including create_idea_bundle, design_experiments, design_hypothesis, evaluate_idea, expand_idea, generate_ideas, get_idea, get_sprint_pack, get_team_knowledge, independent_design_experiments, independent_design_hypothesis, and independent_design_lean_canvas.
